info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Delete Airline Flights Cancel-v5-spec
info.description: The Cancel Airline Flights API allows users to effectively manage flight cancellations within the airline system. This endpoint provides the ability to cancel previously booked flights, ensuring timely updates to customer itineraries. It is primarily utilized by airline staff and systems responsible for booking management and customer service. Whether handling unexpected customer requests or processing operational changes, this API facilitates efficient flight cancellation operations.

delete.description: This endpoint allows users to cancel a specific flight by providing the necessary identifiers. Ensure that the flight is eligible for cancellation according to the airline's policy before calling this endpoint.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify the details needed to cancel a flight. Ensure that the required fields are filled out correctly to process the cancellation.

200.description: The cancellation request was successfully completed.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelRequest.description: The request body for cancelling a flight operation represented as a string.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.title: Cancel Flight Operation Response

status.description: Indicates whether the cancellation operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique identifier for reference regarding the cancellation.

resultId.description: The ID associated with the result of the cancellation process.

state.description: The current state of the cancellation operation.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the cancellation request, in milliseconds.

message.description: A descriptive message related to the cancellation operation.

DeleteAirlineFlightsCancelResponse_200.description: The response schema for a successful cancellation operation of a flight.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user who initiated the cancellation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the cancellation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the cancellation was performed automatically.

AuditInfo.description: Contains information about the audit trail for the cancellation operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time taken to process the request in milliseconds.
